tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Find published AI models on aiblogly.com by name, vendor or category. Returns price per 1M tokens, context window, release date, licence, status and current LMArena rank, each with the model page URL to cite.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: All published facts for one model: vendor price with its conditions, context window, release date, licence, status (retired/deprecated), LMArena rank, vendor source and the date it was checked, plus a one-paragraph summary.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Side-by-side facts for two models (price, context window, release date, licence, LMArena rank) and the aiblogly comparison page URL.

tools.name: top_models
tools.description: The highest-rated models in a category by current LMArena Elo (ranks older than 14 days are excluded), with links to the aiblogly rankings.
